gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-open-sans: Open Sans reads smooth and bulky, its curves never clogging. Capture It sits above it, towering and nearly sealed, and Open Sans gives that heavy display look room to breathe underneath.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-orienta: Orienta's counters breathe wide, and its capitals and lowercase sit close in height, which keeps lines looking level. Capture It stays tightly shut above it, so text under it feels like an opened window.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-oxygen: Towering lowercase, with tube-like strokes that hold through every bend, defines Capture It. Oxygen's curves stay open and its lowercase nearly matches the capitals, so the pair's strongest quality is a tight, dense heading resting on a loose, easygoing body.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-parkinsans: Tall, tight, and urban. Capture It's nearly sealed letters meet Parkinsans, whose single stroke thickness and wide mouths stay crisp even when shrunk, and that sharp split between shut and open is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme has clear, rounded openings and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Capture It keeps its rounds and stems in one weight, and its nearly sealed letters make a firm, dense counterpart to that openness.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-preahvihear: Wire-bent and towering, Capture It holds its letters almost shut, while Preahvihear opens wide like a pried oyster shell with a lofty x-height of its own. Tight above, open below.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-prompt: Blunt and bold-looking, Capture It never mixes heavy and light strokes within a word, while Prompt has oversized small letters with easy open apertures. One commands; the other welcomes.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-pt-sans-caption: Capture It stands tall and urban. It does its best work with towering, nearly sealed letters, while PT Sans Caption offers big-bodied lowercase and inviting, unclosed bowls that carry the actual reading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-puritan: Capture It brings a towering, commanding look with letters nearly sealed shut, and Puritan follows with rounded forms that stay clearly open to the side. Text moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-questrial: Capture It is tall and nearly sealed. Questrial answers with open, flat, single-weight strokes and a tall band of letters under short stalks, which loosens up the whole page beneath that dense heading.
